name: Mount medic
design: Lean elderly female Yautja, pale stone-grey mottled hide, deeply ridged broad cranium, four well-separated ivory mandibular arms, silver-grey heavy scalp tendrils shoulder length. Muted burgundy long wrap tunic under a charcoal short leather bolero, clean off-white cuff wraps and divided apron. Carries a closed bronze-edged veterinary medical case at thigh and holds a folded clean dressing with opposite hand. Exposed film-correct face, no red cross, no logos.
